en.t: Goguryeo defeats Tang forces at the Sasu River
en.s: On 21 February 662, Goguryeo forces led by Yeon Gaesomun defeated a Tang army led by Pang Xiaotai at the Sasu River, in present-day North Korea. The river is tentatively identified with the modern Pothong River.

zh.t: 高句丽军在蛇水之战中击败唐军
zh.s: 662年2月21日，渊盖苏文率领的高句丽军在蛇水击败庞孝泰率领的唐军，地点位于今朝鲜境内。蛇水可能对应今天的普通江，具体河流位置尚不能完全确定。

en.t: Minamoto no Yoshinaka killed at the Battle of Awazu
en.s: On February 21, 1184, Minamoto no Yoshinaka was defeated and killed at Awazu in Ōmi Province, in present-day Japan, during the Genpei War. His companion Imai Kanehira also died in the battle.

zh.t: 源义仲在粟津之战中战败身亡
zh.s: 1184年2月21日，源平合战期间，源义仲在近江国粟津战败身亡，地点位于今日本境内。他的同伴今井兼平也在此役中死亡。

en.t: Milanese forces defeat Lodrisio Visconti at Parabiago
en.s: On 21 February 1339, Milanese forces fighting for Azzone Visconti defeated Lodrisio Visconti’s army near Parabiago in present-day Italy. Luchino Visconti was freed during the fighting, and Lodrisio was captured.

zh.t: 米兰军队在帕拉比亚戈击败洛德里西奥·维斯孔蒂
zh.s: 1339年2月21日，效忠阿佐内·维斯孔蒂的米兰军队在今意大利帕拉比亚戈附近，击败洛德里西奥·维斯孔蒂的军队。卢基诺·维斯孔蒂在战斗中获救，洛德里西奥则被俘。

en.s: The Prussian Confederation (German: Preußischer Bund, Polish: Związek Pruski) was an organization formed on 21 February 1440 at Marienwerder (present-day Kwidzyn) by a group of 53 nobles and clergy and 19 cities in Prussia, to oppose the arbitrariness of the Teutonic Knights. It was based on an earlier similar organization, the Lizard Union established in 1397 by the nobles of Chełmno Land.

zh.s: 普鲁士邦联（德语：Preußischer Bund；波兰语：Związek Pruski）于1440年2月21日在马林韦尔德（今克维曾）成立，由53名贵族和教士以及19座城市组成，旨在反对条顿骑士团的专横统治。该组织以1397年由海乌姆诺地区贵族成立的蜥蜴联盟为基础。

en.t: Rana Sanga’s forces defeat a Mughal detachment at Bayana
en.s: On February 21, 1527, Rana Sanga’s forces defeated a Mughal detachment led by Abdul Aziz near Bayana, in present-day India. The encounter preceded the Battle of Khanwa and weakened morale among Babur’s troops.
en.n: The date refers to the encounter with the Mughal detachment, rather than every stage of the siege of Bayana.

zh.t: 拉纳·桑加的军队在巴亚纳击败莫卧儿分遣队
zh.s: 1527年2月21日，拉纳·桑加的军队在今印度巴亚纳附近击败阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹率领的莫卧儿分遣队。这次交锋发生在汗瓦战役之前，打击了巴布尔军队的士气。
zh.n: 日期指与莫卧儿分遣队的这次交锋，并非巴亚纳围城的所有阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Wayna Daga (Amharic for "grape-cultivating altitude") occurred on 21 February 1543 east of Lake Tana in Ethiopia. Led by the Emperor Galawdewos, the combined army of Ethiopian and Portuguese troops defeated the Adal-Ottoman army led by Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi. Tradition states that Ahmad was killed by a Portuguese musketeer, who had charged alone into the Muslim lines.

zh.s: 瓦伊纳达加战役于1543年2月21日在埃塞俄比亚塔纳湖以东发生，地名在阿姆哈拉语中意为“适合种植葡萄的海拔地带”。加拉德沃斯皇帝率埃塞俄比亚与葡萄牙联军，击败了伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐指挥的阿达尔—奥斯曼联军。传说，一名葡萄牙火枪手独自冲入穆斯林军阵，击毙艾哈迈德。

en.s: The Battle of Kölleryd (Swedish: Slaget vid Kölleryd; Danish: Slaget ved Skillinge/Skillingehed) took place at Skällinge parish on 21 February 1612 during the Kalmar War. The Swedes were commanded by John of Östergötland and Jesper Mattson Cruus, while the Danes were commanded by King Christian IV. The battle ended in a Swedish victory.

zh.s: 克勒吕德战役于1612年2月21日在舍林厄教区发生，属于卡尔马战争。瑞典军由东约特兰的约翰及耶斯佩尔·马特松·克鲁斯指挥，丹麦军由国王克里斯蒂安四世指挥。战役以瑞典获胜告终。丹麦文资料也称此战为斯基林厄或斯基林厄荒原战役。

en.t: Michael Romanov elected tsar (Old Style date)
en.s: On 21 February 1613 in the Julian calendar, equivalent to 3 March in the Gregorian calendar, the Zemsky Sobor in Moscow elected Michael Romanov as tsar of Russia. His coronation took place later.
en.n: February21 is the Julian (Old Style) election date, equivalent to March3,1613 Gregorian; election and coronation are distinct.

zh.t: 米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫当选沙皇（旧历日期）
zh.s: 1613年儒略历2月21日，即公历3月3日，缙绅会议在莫斯科选举米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫为俄罗斯沙皇。他的加冕仪式在之后才举行。
zh.n: 2月21日是儒略历旧历的选举日期，对应公历1613年3月3日。选举与加冕是两个不同阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Martynów - took place at Martynów on 21 February 1699, ending in defeat of the Polish army. It was a battle between the armies of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Crimean Khanate..

zh.s: 马尔蒂诺夫战役于1699年2月21日在马尔蒂诺夫发生，波兰军队战败。交战双方是波兰立陶宛联邦和克里米亚汗国的军队。

en.t: Inverness fort surrenders to Jacobite forces
en.s: On 21 February 1746, Major George Grant surrendered the fort at Inverness, Scotland, in present-day United Kingdom, after Jacobite forces mined its defenses.
en.n: The date follows the historical British account without a calendar conversion.

zh.t: 因弗内斯守军向詹姆斯党军队投降
zh.s: 1746年2月21日，乔治·格兰特少校在今英国苏格兰因弗内斯交出堡垒，向詹姆斯党军队投降。当时进攻方已在堡垒防御工事下挖掘地道。
zh.n: 日期沿用英国历史资料的记载，未作历法转换。

en.s: The attack at Mocodome was a battle which occurred during Father Le Loutre's War in present-day Country Harbour, Nova Scotia on February 21, 1753 which saw two British mariners and six Mi'kmaq killed. The battle ended any hope for the survival of the Treaty of 1752 signed by Governor Peregrine Hopson and Mi'kmaq chief Jean-Baptiste Cope.

zh.s: 莫科多姆袭击是勒卢特尔神父战争期间的一场战斗，于1753年2月21日在今天加拿大新斯科舍省的乡港发生。两名英国水手和六名米克马克人死亡。这场战斗也使1752年由总督佩里格林·霍普森和米克马克人首领让-巴蒂斯特·科普签署的条约失去继续维持的希望。

en.t: Gobir’s ruler declares war on Usman dan Fodio
en.s: On February 21, 1804, Yunfa, ruler of Gobir in present-day Nigeria, declared war on Usman dan Fodio and threatened those joining him. This declaration was a specific initiating phase of the conflict that led to the Sokoto Caliphate.

zh.t: 戈比尔统治者向乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥宣战
zh.s: 1804年2月21日，今尼日利亚境内戈比尔的统治者云法向乌斯曼·丹·福迪奥宣战，并威胁惩罚加入福迪奥阵营的人。这次宣战是后来促成索科托哈里发国建立的战争的起始阶段之一。

en.s: The Finnish War was fought between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Russian Empire from 21 February 1808 to 17 September 1809 as part of the Napoleonic Wars. As a result of the war, the eastern third of Sweden was established as the autonomous Grand Duchy of Finland within the Russian Empire.

zh.s: 芬兰战争是瑞典王国与俄罗斯帝国于1808年2月21日至1809年9月17日进行的战争，属于拿破仑战争的一部分。战后，瑞典东部约三分之一的领土被划为芬兰大公国，成为俄罗斯帝国内的自治地区。

en.s: The Capitulation of Gualcince occurred during the Mexican annexation of El Salvador, on February 21, 1823, when Vicente Filísola after occupying San Salvador continued with a division and forced him to surrender his weapons and surrender.

zh.s: 1823年2月21日，在墨西哥吞并萨尔瓦多期间，比森特·菲利索拉占领圣萨尔瓦多后率一支部队继续推进，迫使对方交出武器并投降。

en.t: Chumash revolt begins at Mission Santa Inés
en.s: On February 21, 1824, the Chumash revolt began at Mission Santa Inés in present-day California, United States, after a Mexican soldier severely beat a young Chumash visitor. The uprising subsequently spread to other missions.

zh.t: 丘马什人在圣伊内斯传教站起义
zh.s: 1824年2月21日，在今美国加利福尼亚州，一名墨西哥士兵重打前来探亲的丘马什少年后，圣伊内斯传教站爆发丘马什人起义。起义随后扩展到其他传教站。

en.s: (For the Battle of Gujarat, see Battle of Surat.) The Battle of Gujrat was a decisive battle in the Second Anglo-Sikh War, fought on 21 February 1849, between the forces of the East India Company, and a Sikh army in rebellion against the Company's control of the Sikh Empire, represented by the child Maharaja Duleep Singh who was in British custody in Lahore. The Sikh army was defeated by the British regular and Bengal Army forces of the British East India Company. After it capitulated a few days later, the Punjab was annexed to the East India Company's territories and Duleep Singh was deposed.

zh.s: 古吉拉特战役是第二次英锡战争的决定性战役，于1849年2月21日发生，地点在今巴基斯坦古吉拉特。它与印度古吉拉特地区的苏拉特战役并非同一场战斗。交战双方是英国东印度公司军队，以及反抗公司控制锡克帝国的锡克军。锡克帝国名义上的君主是年幼的杜利普·辛格，当时他被英国人控制在拉合尔。锡克军被英国正规军及东印度公司的孟加拉军击败，数日后投降。此后，旁遮普被并入东印度公司的领地，杜利普·辛格被废黜。

en.s: Colonial elections were held in South Australia on 21 February 1851. Only 16 of the 24 seats in the unicameral Legislative Council were popularly elected but was the first occurrence of voting franchise in the colony. The 1855 election was the second and last of this type. The 1857 election was the first contest which popularly elected all members to the new bicameral Parliament of South Australia.

zh.s: 1851年2月21日，南澳大利亚举行殖民地选举。立法委员会24个席位中只有16个由选民投票产生，这是该殖民地首次实行选举。1855年的选举是这种选举形式的第二次、也是最后一次。1857年举行的选举则是首次通过选举产生南澳大利亚新两院制议会的全体议员。

en.s: On 21 February 1861, Mariehamn was founded on land belonging to the village of Övernäs in Jomala, Åland, in present-day Finland. The town was named after Empress Maria Alexandrovna.

zh.t: 奥兰群岛的玛丽港建城
zh.s: 1861年2月21日，玛丽港在奥兰群岛约马拉的厄韦内斯村土地上建城，地点位于今芬兰境内。城市以皇后玛丽亚·亚历山德罗芙娜命名。

en.s: The Battle of Valverde, also known as the Battle of Valverde Ford, was fought from February 20 to 21, 1862, near the town of Val Verde at a ford of the Rio Grande in Union-held New Mexico Territory, in what is today the state of New Mexico. It is considered a major Confederate success in the New Mexico Campaign of the American Civil War, despite the invading force abandoning the field.
en.n: American Civil War: Battle of Valverde is fought near Fort Craig in New Mexico Territory.

zh.s: 瓦尔韦德战役又称瓦尔韦德渡口战役，于1862年2月20日至21日在今天美国新墨西哥州的格兰德河渡口附近、当时由联邦控制的新墨西哥领地发生。这场战役是新墨西哥战役中的重要一役。尽管南方军入侵部队后来撤离战场，战役仍被视为南方邦联的一次重大胜利。
zh.n: 美国内战：瓦尔韦德战役在新墨西哥领地克雷格堡附近打响。

en.s: The First Battle of Nowa Wies took place on 21 February 1863 near the village of Nowa Wies, Russian-controlled Congress Poland. It was one of many skirmishes of the January Uprising, the anti-Russian rebellion of Poles. A group of some 600 Polish insurgents under Ludwik Mieroslawski clashed with 500 soldiers of the Imperial Russian Army. The battle ended in Russian victory.

zh.s: 第一次诺瓦维希战役于1863年2月21日在俄国控制的波兰会议王国诺瓦维希村附近发生，是波兰人反俄的一月起义中众多小规模战斗之一。路德维克·米耶罗斯瓦夫斯基率约600名波兰起义者，与500名俄国帝国陆军士兵交战。俄军最终获胜。

en.s: The 1880 Scottish Cup final was the seventh final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1879–80 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. The match was played at Cathkin Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 21 February 1880 and was watched by a crowd estimated as anything between 5,000 and 8,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1880年苏格兰杯决赛是第七届决赛，也是1879—80赛季这项苏格兰最具声望的足球淘汰赛的最后一场比赛。比赛于1880年2月21日在克罗斯希尔的卡思金公园举行；克罗斯希尔如今属于格拉斯哥。现场观众估计在5000至8000人之间。

en.s: The 1885 Scottish Cup final was the 12th final of the Scottish Cup and the final of the 1884–85 Scottish Cup, the most prestigious knockout football competition in Scotland. For only the second time in the competition's history, the final was contested by two teams from outside Glasgow: Renton, who had never won the cup before, and three-time winners Vale of Leven, representing neighbouring communities in Dunbartonshire (their home grounds were approximately 1.6 miles (2.6 km) apart). The original match - which ended in a 0–0 draw - was played at the second Hampden Park in Crosshill (today part of Glasgow) on 21 February 1885 and was watched by a crowd of 3,000 spectators.

zh.s: 1885年苏格兰杯决赛是第12届决赛，也是1884—85赛季这项苏格兰最具声望的足球淘汰赛的最后阶段。决赛由两支格拉斯哥以外的球队对阵，这在赛事历史上仅是第二次：从未夺冠的伦顿，对阵三届冠军利文谷。两队代表邓巴顿郡相邻的社区，主场相距约1.6英里，即2.6公里。首场比赛于1885年2月21日在克罗斯希尔的第二座汉普登公园球场举行，吸引3000名观众，最终0比0战平。克罗斯希尔如今属于格拉斯哥。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 21 February 1887. The National Liberal Party became the largest party in the Reichstag by winning 99 of the 397 seats, whilst the Centre Party, formerly the largest party, was reduced to 98 seats. Voter turnout was 77.5%.

zh.s: 德国于1887年2月21日举行国会选举。民族自由党在397个议席中赢得99席，成为第一大党；原本的第一大党中央党降至98席。投票率为77.5%。

en.s: The Battle of Verdun (French: Bataille de Verdun [bataj də vɛʁdœ̃]; German: Schlacht um Verdun [ʃlaxt ʔʊm ˈvɛɐ̯dœ̃]) was fought from 21 February to 18 December 1916 on the Western Front in France. The battle was the longest of the First World War and took place on the hills north of Verdun.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 凡尔登战役（法语：Bataille de Verdun [bataj də vɛʁdœ̃]；德语：Schlacht um Verdun [ʃlaxt ʔʊm ˈvɛɐ̯dœ̃]）于1916年2月21日至12月18日在法国西线战场进行。这是第一次世界大战中持续时间最长的战役，战场位于凡尔登以北的丘陵地带。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: Northern Column camps at Bir el Giddi after the Nekhl raid
en.s: On February 21, 1917, the Northern Column returning from the raid on Nekhl camped at Bir el Giddi in Sinai, in present-day Egypt. The force had begun its return journey on February 19, after entering Nekhl earlier in the operation.

zh.t: 袭击奈赫勒的北路纵队返程途中在比尔吉迪扎营
zh.s: 1917年2月21日，袭击奈赫勒后返程的北路纵队在今埃及西奈半岛的比尔吉迪扎营。部队此前已进入奈赫勒，并于2月19日开始返程。

en.t: Troops return to El Arish after the raid on Bir el Hassana
en.s: On February 21, 1917, engineers accompanying the force sent to Bir el Hassana returned to El Arish in Egypt. The Hassana garrison had surrendered on February 18; February 21 marks the return phase of the operation, rather than the fighting.
en.n: This entry records the return to El Arish on February 21, not the surrender at Bir el Hassana on February 18.

zh.t: 哈萨纳行动部队的随行工兵返回阿里什
zh.s: 1917年2月21日，随部队前往比尔哈萨纳的工兵返回埃及阿里什。哈萨纳守军已于2月18日投降，2月21日记录的是行动的返程阶段，并非交战当天。
zh.n: 此条记录的是2月21日返回阿里什；比尔哈萨纳守军投降的日期是2月18日。

en.s: The Capture of Jericho occurred between 19 and 21 February 1918 to the east of Jerusalem beginning the Occupation of the Jordan Valley during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of the First World War. Fighting took place in an area bordered by the Bethlehem–Nablus road in the west, the Jordan River in the east, and north of a line from Jerusalem to the Dead Sea. Here a British Empire force attacked Ottoman positions, forcing them back to Jericho and eventually across the Jordan River. Winter rains put an end to campaigning after the advance from the Gaza–Beersheba line to the capture of Jerusalem in December 1917.

zh.s: 1918年2月19日至21日，第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役期间，英帝国部队在耶路撒冷以东发动攻占杰里科的行动，开始占领约旦河谷。战斗区域西至伯利恒—纳布卢斯公路，东至约旦河，位于耶路撒冷至死海连线以北。英军攻击奥斯曼阵地，迫使对方退向杰里科，最终撤过约旦河。此前，英军从加沙—贝尔谢巴防线向前推进，于1917年12月攻占耶路撒冷，随后冬季降雨使军事行动暂时停顿。

en.s: Battle of Varkaus was a battle of the 1918 Finnish Civil War, fought 19–21 February between the Finnish Whites and the Finnish Reds in Varkaus, Leppävirta. The victory was important for the Whites, giving them control of all of Northern Finland. The battle is best known for the bloody Lottery of Huruslahti held afterwards, where the Whites executed up to 180 Reds who had surrendered.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 瓦尔考斯战役是芬兰内战中的一场战斗，于1918年2月19日至21日在芬兰白军与红军之间进行，战场位于瓦尔考斯和莱帕维尔塔。白军获胜后控制了整个芬兰北部。这场战役最为人熟知的是之后发生的胡鲁斯拉赫蒂血腥抽签事件：白军处决了最多180名已投降的红军士兵。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 21 February 1919, Bavarian leader Kurt Eisner was shot dead by Anton Graf von Arco auf Valley in Munich, Germany, while on his way to submit his resignation to parliament.

zh.t: 库尔特·艾斯纳在慕尼黑遇刺身亡
zh.s: 1919年2月21日，巴伐利亚领导人库尔特·艾斯纳在德国慕尼黑前往议会提交辞呈途中，被安东·格拉夫·冯·阿尔科-瓦利枪杀。

en.t: Capture of Tehran during the 1921 Persian coup
en.s: On 21 February 1921, forces of the Persian Cossack Brigade entered Tehran during the coup associated with Reza Khan and Sayyed Zia al-Din Tabatabaee. The capture was almost bloodless. This entry records the capture of Tehran, not the establishment of the Pahlavi dynasty in 1925; the extent of British involvement in planning the coup remains debated.
en.n: Encyclopaedia Iranica explicitly dates the capture of Tehran to Monday, 3 Esfand / 21 February 1921.

zh.t: 1921年波斯政变中的德黑兰占领
zh.s: 1921年2月21日，波斯哥萨克旅部队在礼萨汗和赛义德·齐亚·塔巴塔巴伊参与的政变中进入德黑兰，占领过程几乎没有流血。此条记录的是占领首都，并非1925年巴列维王朝的建立。英国参与策划政变的具体程度仍有争议。
zh.n: 《伊朗百科全书》将占领德黑兰的日期明确记为星期一，即伊朗历埃斯凡德月3日、公历1921年2月21日。

en.s: The 1925 Brisbane City Council election was held on 21 February to elect the Lord Mayor and councillors for each of the 20 wards of the City of Brisbane. The election was the first for the City of Brisbane, which had been created from the amalgamation of 20 local governments the previous year.

zh.s: 1925年2月21日，布里斯班市举行选举，选出市长和该市20个选区的议员。这是布里斯班市首次举行选举；布里斯班市由前一年合并的20个地方政府组成。

en.t: Zhang Zongchang’s rebel forces defeated near Zhifu
en.s: On 21 February 1929, forces led by Zhang Zongchang were defeated by Liu Zhennian’s National Revolutionary Army troops near Zhifu in Shandong, China. The rebels retreated to Dengzhou and the wider rebellion continued.

zh.t: 张宗昌叛军在芝罘附近战败
zh.s: 1929年2月21日，张宗昌率领的叛军在中国山东芝罘附近，被刘珍年指挥的国民革命军击败。叛军退往登州，更大范围的叛乱仍在继续。

en.s: The Battle of Monte Castello (Italian: Battaglia del Monte Castello; German: Schlacht von Monte Castello; Portuguese: Batalha de Monte Castello) was a major engagement fought between 25 November 1944 and 21 February 1945 during the Italian campaign of World War II. Fought in the northern Apennine Mountains, the battle pitted the advancing Allied forces—primarily the Brazilian Expeditionary Force (Força Expedicionária Brasileira – FEB) alongside the US 10th Mountain Division—against heavily entrenched defenders of the Wehrmacht's 232nd Infantry Division.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 蒙特卡斯特洛战役（意大利语：Battaglia del Monte Castello；德语：Schlacht von Monte Castello；葡萄牙语：Batalha de Monte Castello）是第二次世界大战意大利战役中的一场重要战斗，于1944年11月25日至1945年2月21日进行。战斗发生在亚平宁山脉北部，推进中的盟军主要包括巴西远征军和美国陆军第10山地师，对手是依托坚固阵地防守的德国国防军第232步兵师。

en.s: The Battle for the Recapture of Bataan (Filipino: Labanan para sa Bataan) from 31 January to 21 February 1945, by US forces and Allied Filipino guerrillas from the Japanese, part of the campaign for the liberation of the Philippines, was waged to secure the western shore of Manila Bay to enable the use of its harbor and open new supply lines for American troops engaged in the crucial battle for the liberation of Manila.

en.s: A referendum on the formation of the United Arab Republic and appointing Gamal Abdel Nasser as its president was held in Syria on 21 February 1958, alongside a simultaneous referendum in Egypt. The formation of the UAR was approved by 100% of voters, with only 139 voting against, whilst Nasser was approved as president by a similar margin.

zh.t: 1958年叙利亚阿拉伯联合共和国公投
zh.s: 1958年2月21日，叙利亚就成立阿拉伯联合共和国，以及任命贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔为总统举行公投，埃及也同时投票。原文称成立共和国的赞成率为100%，同时记载139票反对，数字存在不一致。纳赛尔出任总统也以相近的悬殊票差获得通过。

en.s: A referendum on the creation of the United Arab Republic was held in Egypt on 21 February 1958, alongside a simultaneous referendum in Syria. The referendum consisted of two questions; one on the formation of the UAR, and the other on Gamal Abdel Nasser's candidacy for the post of President of the UAR. Both were approved, with reported results of fewer than 300 votes against, and a 98% voter turnout.

zh.t: 1958年埃及阿拉伯联合共和国公投
zh.s: 1958年2月21日，埃及就成立阿拉伯联合共和国举行公投，叙利亚也在同日举行公投。公投包含两个问题：是否成立阿拉伯联合共和国，以及贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔是否出任该国总统。两项提案均获通过；据报反对票不到300张，投票率为98%。

en.s: On February 21, 1965, Malcolm X was assassinated while preparing to address a meeting at the Audubon Ballroom in New York City, United States.

zh.s: 1965年2月21日，马尔科姆·X在美国纽约奥杜邦舞厅准备向与会者发表讲话时，遭枪击身亡。

Elections to State Assemblies were also held simultaneously, the last general election to do so. The incumbent Indian National Congress government retained power, albeit with a significantly reduced majority.

en.t: Beypore votes in Kerala’s legislative assembly election
en.s: On February 21, 1967, Beypore constituency voted in Kerala’s legislative assembly election in India, according to the Election Commission’s official constituency summary. The seat was won by K. C. Master of the Communist Party of India (Marxist).
en.n: The polling date follows the Election Commission’s Beypore constituency summary; it does not establish that every Kerala constituency voted on the same day.

zh.t: 喀拉拉邦贝普尔选区举行议会投票
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度喀拉拉邦贝普尔选区举行邦议会投票。印度选举委员会的官方选区汇总表将当天列为投票日。印度共产党（马克思主义）候选人K. C. Master最终赢得该席位。
zh.n: 投票日期采用印度选举委员会对贝普尔选区的记载，不代表喀拉拉邦各选区均在同一天投票。

en.t: Bhander election result declares Kishorilal Hans elected
en.s: On February 21, 1967, the result of the Bhander legislative assembly election in Madhya Pradesh, India, was declared. Kishorilal Hans was declared elected after polling on February 20; his eligibility for the reserved seat was subsequently challenged in court.
en.n: This is a constituency result declaration, not the polling date for the whole state.

zh.t: 班德尔选区公布结果，基肖里拉尔·汉斯获宣布当选
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度中央邦班德尔选区公布邦议会选举结果，基肖里拉尔·汉斯获宣布当选。投票在前一天举行。此后，他是否具备该保留席位的参选资格成为诉讼争议。
zh.n: 这是具体选区公布结果的日期，并非全邦的投票日期。

en.t: Bihar holds a polling phase in its assembly election
en.s: On February 21, 1967, Bihar in India held the fourth polling phase listed for its legislative assembly election. Earlier phases took place on February 15, 17 and 19.
en.n: This records one of four listed polling dates, rather than a single voting day for the entire state.

zh.t: 比哈尔邦举行议会选举第四阶段投票
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度比哈尔邦举行该次邦议会选举的第四阶段投票。此前三个阶段分别在2月15日、17日和19日举行。
zh.n: 这次选举分四个日期投票，此处并非指全邦在同一天投票。

en.t: Udaipur City election result declares Mohan Lal Sukhadia elected
en.s: On February 21, 1967, the result of the Udaipur City legislative assembly election in Rajasthan, India, was declared, returning Mohan Lal Sukhadia of the Indian National Congress. Polling in this constituency had taken place on February 15.
en.n: This is a constituency result declaration, not the polling date for the whole state.

zh.t: 乌代布尔市选区公布结果，苏卡迪亚当选
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度拉贾斯坦邦乌代布尔市选区公布邦议会选举结果，印度国民大会党候选人莫汉·拉尔·苏卡迪亚当选。该选区已于2月15日投票。
zh.n: 这是具体选区公布结果的日期，并非全邦的投票日期。

en.t: Gajwel constituency votes in Andhra Pradesh’s assembly election
en.s: On February 21, 1967, Gajwel constituency voted in the Andhra Pradesh legislative assembly election in India. Gajwelli Saidiah of the Indian National Congress was subsequently declared elected. Gajwel is now in Telangana.
en.n: This is the polling date for Gajwel constituency, not a statewide result declaration.

zh.t: 加杰韦尔选区举行邦议会投票
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度安得拉邦加杰韦尔选区举行邦议会投票。印度国民大会党候选人Gajwelli Saidiah随后获宣布当选。加杰韦尔如今属于特伦甘纳邦。
zh.n: 这是加杰韦尔选区的投票日期，并非全邦公布结果的日期。

en.t: Chhamb constituency votes in Jammu and Kashmir’s assembly election
en.s: On February 21, 1967, Chhamb constituency in Jammu and Kashmir, India, voted in the legislative assembly election. The creation of additional polling stations shortly before the vote later became the subject of an election challenge.
en.n: This is the polling date for Chhamb constituency, not a claim that every constituency voted on the same day.

zh.t: 查姆布选区举行邦议会投票
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度查谟和克什米尔的查姆布选区举行邦议会投票。投票前临时增设部分投票站的做法，后来成为选举诉讼的争议。
zh.n: 这是查姆布选区的投票日期，不代表所有选区均在同一天投票。

en.t: Madras State assembly election reaches its final polling day
en.s: On February 21, 1967, the Madras State legislative assembly election in India reached its final polling day. The election was held in several phases, and the Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam subsequently formed the state government.

zh.t: 马德拉斯邦议会选举完成最后阶段投票
zh.s: 1967年2月21日，印度马德拉斯邦议会选举进入最后一个投票日。选举分阶段进行，德拉维达进步联盟随后组建邦政府。

en.s: The Marlborough by-election of 1970 was a by-election for the electorate of Marlborough, held on 21 February 1970 during the 30th New Zealand Parliament. The by-election resulted from the death of Tom Shand on 11 December 1969, only 12 days after he (and the government) had been re-elected on 29 November; and the new National candidate was defeated by the greatest swing against a government since the 1935 general election, in what was a largely rural electorate generally regarded a safe National seat. Tom Shand had held the seat from 1946, when he defeated Labour’s Edwin Meachen.

zh.s: 1970年2月21日，新西兰第30届议会任期内，马尔堡选区举行补选。原任议员汤姆·尚德在1969年11月29日与执政党一同赢得连任，却在12天后的12月11日去世，因此议席出缺。这个以乡村为主的选区向来被视为国家党的稳固选区，但该党新候选人仍然落败，并遭遇1935年大选以来选票向反对政府一方转移幅度最大的一次结果。尚德自1946年击败工党的埃德温·米钦后，一直担任该区议员。

en.s: The Convention on Psychotropic Substances of 1971 is a United Nations treaty designed to control psychoactive drugs such as , barbiturates, benzodiazepines, and psychedelics signed in Vienna, Austria on 21 February 1971. The Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs of 1961 could not ban the many newly discovered psychotropics, since its scope was limited to drugs with cannabis, coca, and opium-like effects. During the 1960s such drugs became widely available, and government authorities opposed this for numerous reasons, arguing that along with negative health effects, drug use led to lowered moral standards.

zh.s: 1971年《精神药物公约》是一项联合国条约，于1971年2月21日在奥地利维也纳签署，旨在管制巴比妥类、苯二氮䓬类和致幻剂等精神活性药物。1961年《麻醉品单一公约》的范围仅限于具有大麻、古柯及鸦片类似作用的药物，无法禁止许多新发现的精神药物。20世纪60年代，这些药物变得容易取得，各国当局出于多种理由反对，认为它们除损害健康外，还会使道德标准下降。

en.s: Libyan Arab Airlines Flight 114 was a regularly scheduled international passenger flight from Tripoli, Libya, to Cairo, Egypt, through Benghazi in Libya. The flight was shot down on 21 February 1973 by two Israeli McDonnell Douglas F-4 fighter jets after it mistakenly entered the airspace of Egypt's Sinai Peninsula – then under Israeli occupation – resulting in the death of 108 passengers and crew, with 5 survivors.

zh.t: 利比亚阿拉伯航空114号班机被击落
zh.s: 利比亚阿拉伯航空114号班机是从利比亚的黎波里出发、经班加西飞往埃及开罗的定期国际客运航班。1973年2月21日，飞机误入当时由以色列占领的埃及西奈半岛空域，被两架以色列麦克唐纳道格拉斯F-4战斗机击落，108名乘客及机组人员遇难，5人生还。

en.s: On February 21, 2020, voters in the Tehran, Rey, Shemiranat and Eslamshahr constituency in Iran voted in the parliamentary election. A conservative unity list ultimately won all 30 seats in the constituency.

zh.t: 德黑兰选区举行伊朗议会选举
zh.s: 2020年2月21日，伊朗德黑兰、雷伊、谢米兰纳特和埃斯兰沙赫尔选区举行议会选举。保守派联合名单最终赢得该选区全部30个席位。

en.t: ACA104: Goncharov vs. Vakhaev held in Krasnodar
en.s: On February 21, 2020, ACA 104: Goncharov vs. Vakhaev, a mixed martial arts event, took place at Basket-Hall in Krasnodar, Russia.

zh.t: ACA第104期赛事在克拉斯诺达尔举行
zh.s: 2020年2月21日，ACA第104期综合格斗赛在俄罗斯克拉斯诺达尔的Basket-Hall体育馆举行，赛事以贡恰罗夫与瓦哈耶夫的对决为主赛。

en.t: CMLL holds the second block of its National Incredible Pairs tournament
en.s: On February 21, 2020, CMLL held the second qualifying block of its National Incredible Pairs tournament at Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. The tournament ran across three shows, with the final on February 28.
en.n: This records the second qualifying block, not the final or the entire three-show tournament.

zh.t: CMLL全国奇异搭档锦标赛举行第二组预选赛
zh.s: 2020年2月21日，CMLL全国奇异搭档锦标赛在墨西哥城墨西哥竞技场举行第二组预选赛。这届赛事分三场演出进行，决赛于2月28日举行。
zh.n: 此条记录第二组预选赛，并非决赛，也不是整届赛事在一天内完成。

en.s: The 2021 Elimination Chamber (known as No Escape in Germany) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 11th Elimination Chamber event and due to the COVID-19 pandemic, it took place on February 21, 2021, from the WWE ThunderDome, a bio-secure bubble that at the time was hosted at Tropicana Field in St.

zh.s: “铁笼密室淘汰赛2021”是WWE举办的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，在德国名为“无处可逃”，参赛者来自主力品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是第11届铁笼密室淘汰赛。受新冠疫情影响，比赛于2021年2月21日在WWE“雷霆巨蛋”举行，这是一个实行防疫隔离的封闭赛场，当时设在纯品康纳球场。原文在介绍球场所在城市时中断。

en.s: General elections were held in Niger on 27 December 2020 to elect the President and National Assembly. With incumbent president Mahamadou Issoufou stepping down after reaching his constitutional two-term limit, new presidential candidates contested the office. As no candidate received a majority in the first round, a second round was held on 21 February 2021.
en.n: This entry records the second round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 尼日尔于2020年12月27日举行大选，选出总统和国民议会议员。时任总统马哈马杜·伊素福达到宪法规定的两届任期上限后卸任，新的总统候选人参加角逐。由于首轮无人获得过半数选票，第二轮投票于2021年2月21日举行。
zh.n: 此条记录的是原文资料框所列的第二轮投票日期。

en.t: Chuck Grassie wins a New Hampshire House election rerun
en.s: On February 21, 2023, Chuck Grassie won a special election for a New Hampshire House seat in Rochester, United States. The election was rerun after the November 2022 contest with David Walker ended in a 970–970 tie.

zh.t: 查克·格拉西在新罕布什尔州重新选举中胜出
zh.s: 2023年2月21日，查克·格拉西在美国新罕布什尔州罗切斯特一个州众议院席位的特别选举中胜出。他与戴维·沃克在2022年11月的选举中同获970票，因此举行了重新选举。

en.t: Jennifer McClellan wins Virginia’s4th district special election
en.s: On February 21, 2023, Jennifer McClellan won the special election for Virginia’s 4th congressional district in the United States, filling the vacancy left by Donald McEachin’s death.

zh.t: 詹妮弗·麦克莱伦赢得弗吉尼亚州第四选区补选
zh.s: 2023年2月21日，詹妮弗·麦克莱伦赢得美国弗吉尼亚州第四国会选区特别选举，填补唐纳德·麦克伊钦去世后留下的联邦众议院席位。

en.t: 2025 Jaintia Hills Autonomous District Council election
en.s: Elections to the Jaintia Hills Autonomous District Council (JHADC) were held on 21 February 2025. Of the 30 seats, 29 seats were open for election and one remaining seat is nominated. The NPP emerged as the single largest party by winning 13 seats, but fell short of the required majority of 15. It later formed the government in coalition with the UDP.

zh.t: 2025年贾因蒂亚山区自治县议会选举
zh.s: 贾因蒂亚山区自治县议会于2025年2月21日举行选举。30个议席中，29席通过选举产生，余下1席由任命产生。全国人民党赢得13席，成为第一大党，但未达到所需的15席多数，随后与联合民主党组成联合政府。

en.t: 2025 Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council election
en.s: Elections to the Khasi Hills Autonomous District Council (KHADC) were held on 21 February 2025. Of the 30 seats, 29 seats were open for election and one remaining seat is nominated. The VPP won majority by winning 17 seats.

zh.t: 2025年卡西山区自治县议会选举
zh.s: 卡西山区自治县议会于2025年2月21日举行选举。30个议席中，29席通过选举产生，余下1席由任命产生。人民之声党赢得17席，取得多数。
